Name: Crab Instead of Mermaid
Author: pixeltechnician
Description:
This mod replaces all sprites of the Mermaid from the Night Market with crabs. Awesome, happy, dancing crabs. If I knew how to add crab rave music instead, I would. Maybe I'll look into that.

Awesome.

To make this happen, navigate to your games local files and replace the following files with these modded versions.

You want to replace "night_market_tilesheet_objects" which is located in: "Stardew Valley\Content\Maps" with my edited version.

And do the same with "temporary_sprites_1" which is located in: "Stardew Valley\Content\LooseSprites", again with my edited version of the file of the same name.

That's all there is to it. Back up your originals as always just in case something happens. But this worked perfectly on my end!

CRABS

Downloads.Description: Just replace your existing files of the same name within your own copy of the game.
